lines.t: I was lost in the noise, chasing every high
Flashing colors in my eyes, but my heart was dry
All the speakers were loud, but I couldn’t hear
Till Your whisper cut through every doubt and fear
Now the dark starts fading when You say my name
Every shadow breaks under Your flame
Feel the pulse of heaven running through my veins
I will never be the same
YahuShua, light up this night
Turn my darkness into neon skies
Every heartbeat moving with Your fire
Lifting me higher, higher
YahuShua, light up this night
Let Your glory flood these strobe‑lit lights
Every step I dance, I’m alive
In Your love I come to life
Light it up, light it up (oh‑oh)
Light it up, light it up (oh‑oh)
YahuShua, light up this night
Light it up, light it up (oh‑oh)
